reasoning_trace.value: The paper presents a photonics-aided THz integrated sensing and communication system based on a subcarrier-chirp inter-embedded waveform. The system uses a coherent optical frequency comb (OFC) for up-conversion and achieves simultaneous 88-Gbps data rate and 8-mm radial resolution over a 10.2-m wireless transmission.

reasoning_trace.description: Explain the System Mechanism and ISAC Coupling Mode found.
reasoning_trace.value: The system mechanism is based on a subcarrier-chirp inter-embedded (SCIE) method, which embeds subcarrier communication signals in the idle time-frequency gaps of a linear frequency-modulated continuous wave (LFMCW). The ISAC coupling mode is a co-time and co-frequency (CTCF) mode, where the sensing and communication functions share the same time and frequency resources.
